penalties.authority: Customs, Excise and Service Tax Appellate Tribunal
penalties.details: The Customs, Excise and Service Tax Appellate Tribunal has set aside the order passed by the learned Commissioner of Central Excise, Customs and Service Tax, Nashik-II, dated December 14, 2016, which had disallowed the CENVAT credit and imposed a penalty of Rs. 5,00,000 on the Head Office of the Company at Thane. The Company had filed an appeal against the said order, pursuant to which the Appellate Tribunal set aside the order of the Commissioner by allowing the CENVAT credit and reducing the penalty imposed on the Head Office of the Company to Rs. 1,00,000.
penalties.impact: No impact on financial, operational or other activities of the Company except the penalty amount of Rs. 1,00,000.

operating_notes.text: Human Healthcare contributed 63% of total revenue in FY26, growing 15% year-to-date.
Q1FY27 working capital cycle was 125-138 days, with inventory at ₹190 Cr, receivables at ₹131 Cr, and payables at ₹41 Cr
US business growth is expected at 8-10% for FY27, facing challenges from geopolitical issues and a transition to a branding-focused business model
H1FY27 operating cash flow was ₹77.2 Cr, representing 86% of net profit.
Inventory levels increased to ₹202.71 Cr as of September 30, 2026, from ₹177.28 Cr in March 2026.
The company utilized ₹517.34 million from the securities premium account for the buyback.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹203.37 Cr (+21.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹42.96 Cr (+62.2% YoY).
Advanced Enzyme reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹203.37 Cr (+22% YoY) and net profit of ₹45.3 Cr (+69% YoY).
Vasant L. Rathi, as promoter, declared no new encumbrances on Advanced Enzyme Technologies Limited shares on April 7, 2026, with Persons Acting in Concert listed.
Advanced Enzyme completed an additional investment of ₹0.25 Cr in its wholly owned subsidiary Advanced Nutrazyme Private Limited.

Advanced Enzyme Technologies Limited held its Q1FY27 earnings conference call on August 12, 2026, reporting revenue of ₹189.79 Cr (+2% YoY), EBITDA of ₹51 Cr (-10% YoY), and announcing a ₹69.7 Cr buyback and the acquisition of the remaining 4.28% stake in JC Biotech for ₹7.98 Cr.
Advanced Enzyme Technologies Limited closed its ₹69.7 Cr open market buyback on October 30, 2026, repurchasing 2,410,906 shares.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹214.51 Cr (+16.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹48.31 Cr (+11.5% YoY).
